read.passage: My name is Sam. I live in a town by the sea. There is a beach and there are lots of boats. On Saturday, I get up at eight o'clock. My dad and I go to the market. Dad buys fish, and I ask, 'How much are the grapes?' In winter, it's windy here. My mum wears a big coat.

options: in a town by the sea
